questions.q: How should the factory file list reach the worker that repoints the eight factory globs in run/permissions-diff.py SURFACE?
options: Re-run on a fleet worker holding both the gates and factory clones
Grant this task's cloud session read access to the factory repository
Captain commits factory's git ls-files as .ci/fixtures/surface-paths/factory.txt first, then re-run
questions.default: Re-run on a fleet worker holding both the gates and factory clones
questions.why: This session's GitHub access is scoped to gates only, so factory's tracked paths could not be read; repointing without them would be guessing paths for security-surface globs. The suite half (fix-sr2-7, #80) is already on main; only the fixture, the glob moves and dropping factory from AWAITING remain. The change edits run/permissions-diff.py, which the gate protects, so it is class 2.

followups.text: Enforce freshness of .ci/fixtures/surface-paths/<repo>.txt: a stale fixture keeps a moved glob green.
followups.acceptance: test-surface-paths.py (or bin/gates.py bump) fails or regenerates when a fixture's recorded commit differs from the commit the repository's .github/gates.lock is moved at.
